Deep Agents Overview

Build agents that can plan, use subagents, and leverage file systems for complex tasks.

When to use Deep Agents

Deep Agents are designed for complex, multi-step tasks that require:

  • Planning and Decomposition: Managing tasks that need to be broken down into smaller steps.
  • Context Management: Handling large amounts of context using file system tools.
  • Subagent Delegation: Spawning specialized subagents for context isolation and specific tasks.
  • Persistence: Maintaining memory across conversations and threads.

Core Capabilities

Planning and Task Decomposition

Agents can maintain a to-do list to track progress and plan future actions.

write_todos

Context Management

Agents interact with a virtual filesystem to manage their context, preventing context window overflow.

  • ls: List files
  • read_file: Read file content
  • write_file: Create new files
  • edit_file: Modify existing files

Subagent Spawning

Agents can delegate work to subagents using the task tool, allowing for hierarchical task execution.

Command Line Interface

The Deep Agents CLI is the fastest way to build and interact with your agents.

Quickstart 
# 1. Install the CLI
uv tool install deepagents-cli deepagents

# 2. Set your API key
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-api-key"

# 3. Give the agent a task
deepagents "Create a Python script that prints 'Hello, World!'"

Relationship to LangChain Ecosystem

  • LangGraph: Provides the underlying graph execution and state management.
  • LangChain: Tools and model integrations work seamlessly with deep agents.
  • LangSmith: Used for observability, evaluation, and deployment.
